method: Two AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI) each get 3 independent clean-room runs against the same prompt and same broken code. Hidden test suite result and a hand-validated supplementary check are recorded per run.

fully_verified_cells.split_note: Claude's guard blocks a second concurrent completion; Codex's does not.

fully_verified_cells.note: Supplementary check swept 6 currencies with different minor-unit digits (USD/JPY/KRW/BHD/KWD/OMR), 6/6 allCorrect.
Hidden suite is 5 assertions: cross-account blocked, same-account still works, wrong-token rejected, expiry-boundary-plus-wrong-account rejected, one-time-use retained.
No actual deletion occurred; synthetic function test of a credential-isolation design risk.
One Codex run flagged tests_change=altered, disclosed and not yet reviewed in detail.

fully_verified_cells.split_note: Claude 3/3 correct total; Codex 3/3 silently drops second payment's credit on undefined paymentIntentId.

anti_claim_standing: No result on this page generalizes beyond the stated fixture, run count, and single session. A pattern is only treated as a repeatable finding once it reproduces in a different risk domain and a different publication cohort.
license_note: This file summarizes internal test records. It is provided for transparency, not as a benchmark leaderboard.
